regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.5% while CPI jumped from 7.29% to 11.08% in three months, so real rates are about zero and the next move is likelier up than down. KMI is up 25.4% in three months, so the easy part of the rally is behind us. Holds have historically been mildly positive over 60 sessions (62% hit, in sample). Neutral: modest core in cheap, high-yield names, no leveraged opportunity bets.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.5%; last MPC decision 2026-06-15: hold (+0bp)
CPI YoY 11.08% for 2026-06 (published by 2026-07-03); three months earlier (2026-03) 7.29%
Regime: 6M T-bill minus policy rate +0.25pp (market near policy rate); CPI rising over 3 months (+3.8pp)
Lesson: hold bills, and set a trigger to return.

core.thesis: Low multiple, 6.8% yield, at its 252-day high. Breakout-to-high cohort shows 62% hit rate (suggestive only). E&P sector is up 24% in three months, so size is kept small.
Lowest P/E and highest yield among liquid names here, at its 252-day high, with EPS roughly flat year on year. Paid to wait while the rate path is unclear.
Islamic bank at a 252-day high, P/E 8.8, yield 6.3%. Bank-sector flows show mutual funds buying commercial banks over 20 sessions. EPS growth is flat, so this is carry, not a growth call.
